title: Humber River Kayaking
locationName: Toronto Adventures Humber River Paddling Center
description: Rent kayaks and paddle the Humber River from the Toronto Adventures launch near Old Mill.
transportationNotes: Located in King's Mill Park near Old Mill. Arrive at least 15 minutes early for check-in and orientation. Bring government photo ID, water, sunscreen, and shoes that can get wet.
costLabel: Weekend 2-hour single kayak $49.95 plus tax per person; tandem kayak $89.95 plus tax for two
imagePrompt: A relaxed summer kayaking trip on Toronto's Humber River, with two friends paddling through calm green water near Old Mill and city nature in the background.
notes: Picked Saturday, June 20, 2026 from 1 PM to 3 PM as a near-term weekend placeholder. Toronto Adventures lists 2-hour rentals May-October 2026. Included gear: boat, paddle, PFD/life jacket, Coast Guard safety kit, and a brief orientation. Paddlers must be comfortable treading water with a PFD and reaching shore. Late return fee is $20 per 15 minutes per boat. Confirm weather and availability before booking.

title: Karaoke Room Night
description: Rent a karaoke room for a 4-6 person music night.
transportationNotes: Echo is near Christie Station in Koreatown. For 4-6 people, the Audition Room is the best price fit; upgrade to Rehearsal Room if the group wants more space.
imagePrompt: A lively karaoke room with microphones, neon lights, a big song screen, and snacks on a table.
notes: Planning research for 4-6 people: Echo Karaoke Audition Room is $40/hour, max 6 people, plus a $5 service fee. Split 4 ways that is about $10/person/hour before the fee; split 6 ways that is about $6.67/person/hour before the fee. Echo also lists Rehearsal Room at $50/hour max 10 people plus $5 fee, Showtime Room at $60/hour max 15 plus $10 fee, and Grand Stage Room at $100/hour max 25 plus $15 fee. Public price pages for other local karaoke room options were harder to verify, so call before choosing a non-Echo venue.
